reason: The hypothesis proposes a controlled comparison between intentionally homogenized and intentionally segregated samples of the same MPEA to isolate the effect of chemical homogeneity on oxidation resistance. This specific experimental design, linking processing-induced homogeneity directly to oxide scale continuity and mechanical integrity, is not proposed or tested in any of the provided passages, which focus on alloy composition, microstructure (e.g., grain size, eutectic structure), or reactive elements.
